items.exampleEn: It's not easy to reach an agreement when everyone is tired.
items.exampleZh: 大家都累的時候，很難達成協議。

items.exampleEn: Before you sign a contract, read it carefully.
items.exampleZh: 簽約之前，要仔細閱讀內容。

items.exampleEn: To join the program, submit an application online.
items.exampleZh: 想參加這個計畫，請在網路上提交申請。

items.exampleEn: Who will take responsibility for buying the snacks?
Many students take advantage of free online courses.
items.exampleZh: 很多學生利用免費的線上課程。

items.exampleEn: This price doesn't take tax into account.
items.exampleZh: 這個價格沒有把稅考慮進去。

items.exampleEn: Some workers like to work overtime for extra pay.
items.exampleZh: 有些員工喜歡加班多賺一點錢。

items.sentenceEn: Let's take advantage of the good weather today.
items.sentenceZh: 今天天氣很好，我們好好把握吧。

items.audioEn: I've had to work overtime every day this week, so I'm going to sleep all weekend.
items.audioZh: 我這週每天都得加班，所以整個週末我都要拿來睡覺。
items.questionZh: 說話者這個週末打算做什麼？
options: Rest at home and get some sleep
Go back to the office to finish work
Travel to the mountains with friends

items.sentenceEn: The singer signed a contract with a new company.
items.sentenceZh: 那位歌手和一家新公司簽了約。

items.sentenceEn: Each team member must take responsibility for one task.
items.sentenceZh: 每位組員都必須負責一項工作。

items.stemEn: When planning the trip, we ____ the cost of meals.
items.stemZh: 規劃旅行時，我們把餐費也考慮進去了。

items.stemEn: After hours of talks, the two companies finally ____.
items.stemZh: 經過好幾個小時的談判，兩家公司終於達成協議。

items.passageEn: Sam wanted to work at a hotel in another city, so he submitted an application in March. The manager liked his work experience, and two weeks later, Sam signed a contract for one year. Before saying yes, he took many things into account, such as the cost of rent and the long working hours. He knows he will sometimes have to work overtime during the busy season, but he is excited to start.
items.passageZh: Sam 想到另一個城市的飯店工作，所以他三月提交了申請。經理很欣賞他的工作經驗，兩週後，Sam 簽了一年的合約。答應之前，他考慮了很多事，例如房租和很長的工作時數。他知道旺季時有時得加班，但他還是很期待開始工作。

options: Sam 願意每天加班到很晚

questions.questionZh: Sam 答應之前考慮了哪些事？
options: 飯店的位置和員工的人數

items.promptZh: 我爸爸上個月加班了十次。
referenceEn: My dad worked overtime ten times last month.
Last month, my father worked overtime ten times.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「加班」（例如 worked overtime 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 did overtime 等）
有「上個月」，用過去式（例如 worked overtime 等）

items.promptZh: 她昨天向那家銀行提交了申請。
referenceEn: She submitted an application to the bank yesterday.
Yesterday she submitted an application to that bank.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「提交申請」（例如 submitted an application to the bank 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 applied to the bank、handed in / sent an application 等）
有「昨天」，用過去式（例如 submitted 等）
「那家銀行」可寫，例如 the bank、that bank 等
